summary: Learn financial AI model classification, validation, and governance with practical case exercises. Explore the course and build usable risk artefacts.
lede: AI model risk management training helps financial risk, analytics, and audit professionals organize oversight of AI and machine-learning models. Participants practise building model inventories and classification matrices, planning independent validation and stress tests, assessing fairness and explainability, and documenting governance and monitoring controls through credit, fraud, and customer analytics scenarios; generative AI controls are covered at an operational planning level, without coding or production deployment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for financial professionals responsible for assessing, governing, validating, or overseeing AI and machine-learning models in regulated institutions.
modules: Financial Model Validation and Stress Testing
AI Model Risk Reporting and Remediation
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial risk, credit or fraud analytics, model governance, or model validation is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use model-risk case materials and spreadsheet-based workflows. Bring a laptop with access to a spreadsheet application such as Microsoft Excel.
